_meta.method: Manual reading of base/<idx>/final_payload.json (payload summary: a4/summ.txt, from scripts/a4_summ.py) against the source paper text (scripts/a4_grep.py quotes), the eval_v2 gold supplement and pinned_v1 gold, and public references (Reactome, WikiPathways, PathBank, UniProt). No pipeline, test or scorer was run; gold scores are a manual reaction-by-reaction match, not the eval_v2 scorer.
_meta.bucket_legend: A = the final payload itself is wrong vs the paper (extraction / mapping / pre-freeze stages). B = payload right, PWML/IR misrepresents it (exporter/IR).
_meta.count_legend: correct = distinct paper-supported steps with right substrate/product (enzyme problems listed under wrong); duplicates are not counted as correct.
